    • applyDeadzone

      public static double applyDeadzone(double value, double deadzone)
      Compares a value, typically a stick input, to a deadzone to filter unintended inputs
      Parameters:
      value - The input value to test
      deadzone - The threshold below which the input is considered noise.
      Returns:
      0.0 if the value is less than or equal to the deadzone; otherwise the original value.
